approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would take money from the government's main bank account to pay for services that fall outside its regular yearly functions.
It is one of three bills that together provide extra funding for spending decisions made since the 2024-25 budget.
Detailed information on each proposed payment appears in the Portfolio Additional Estimates Statements that accompany these bills.
Creates new spending authority for non-ordinary annual services.
Provides additional appropriations beyond those already passed for the 2024-25 financial year.
Ties each payment to details published in the Portfolio Additional Estimates Statements.
The Australian Government and the departments and agencies that receive the appropriated funds.

Supported additional appropriation bills providing $12 billion for the remainder of the financial year, including $7 billion for ordinary annual services, while arguing that government economic management had worsened inflation, living costs, energy prices and business conditions; debate was interrupted.
